facts.fact: The Eswatini Observer reported that lenders could not access IFMIS from about 29 September 2026 during an ongoing government digital outage, which the Ministry of ICT listed as affecting IFMIS.

The Times of Eswatini reported that an incident at the National Data Centre disrupted at least 12 government platforms including IFMIS; RSTP had first acknowledged the web-services outage including IFMIS on 18 September 2026.
The Ministry of ICT acknowledged on 23 September 2026 ongoing outages of government platforms including IFMIS, with no cause given and no restoration date.

facts.fact: Eswatini's ICT ministry said on 23 October 2026 that the Integrated Financial Management Information System (IFMIS) was among 13 services restored after disruptions.

Eswatini Positive News reports that, for the first time, all ministries, departments and agencies are entering their plans and budgets directly into the new IFMIS, with all modules and exclusive in-system payments expected by April 2026 to replace a 1992 mainframe.

note: Passports and eVisas are not core finance, revenue or payroll systems.
Company registration and manual ERS payments are not a core finance, revenue or payroll system stated in use or down.
